tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground for the website, README graphics and app windows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and dialogs on `paper`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset areas: code blocks, input fields, status bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers, decorative only (below 3:1). Control borders use `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` (at least 15:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, control borders on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` (at least 5.3:1).

tokens.name: petrol
tokens.usage: Brand colour: front of the mark, links, primary buttons. As text on `paper` and `surface` (at least 6.2:1).

tokens.name: petrol-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `petrol` fills.

tokens.name: petrol-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: selection, callouts, illustration grounds. Text on it in `ink`.

tokens.name: on-petrol
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `petrol` and `petrol-strong` (at least 6.6:1).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: The back of the fold: the flap in the mark, highlights, badges. Never as text on light grounds (1.7:1); allowed as text in the dark theme (10:1).

tokens.name: on-saffron
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `saffron` (9.8:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Light 7.3:1, dark 10:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: app-cloudcraft

tokens.name: app-issuecraft
